italian.line: But what are we going to do about the Italian?
stanza: But what are we going to do about the Italian?

medallion.line: She silently slips from her throat a medallion
stanza: She tells me she comes from my mother the mountain
And her skin fits her tightly and her lips do not lie
She silently slips from her throat a medallion
Slowly she twirls it in front of my eyes

stallion.line: Well if I had a buckskin stallion
stanza: Well if I had a buckskin stallion
I'd tame him down and ride away
And if I had a flying schooner
I'd sail into the light of day
If I had your love forever
Sail into the light of day
